selection: First 50 scene IDs, without selecting by activity, errors or convergence.

limitations: Historical research scenes; not untouched test data.
White-trained denoiser and its matched classifier; all numerical receiver controls unchanged.

query_variance_update.schedule: one update per outer iteration; ratio damped with existing beta; separate raw linear-query covariance history
query_variance_update.stop: also require relative posterior-residual variance update below original convergence tolerance

stopping_policy: Run all actual iterations; keep native stopping diagnostics; no padding
scoring: Sum per-user squared errors / sum active signal energy, then convert to dB; pooled AER
observer_note: Truth is used only by the passive trajectory scorer; never by receiver updates
timing_note: Timing includes scoring and extra SBL posterior reconstruction; not a runtime benchmark
